caption: The drawing depicts a marionette with visible control strings attached to its head, hands, and body. The puppet has a striking face painted in shades of orange and pink with pronounced facial features, including a pointed nose, a small beard, and eyebrows angled down toward its nose. It wears a blue turban with a red wrap accent, and a blue outer robe that has yellow lining visible at the front and sleeve cuffs. Underneath the robe, the figure wears loose, brown trousers, and a white and red striped sash tied around the waist. The marionette's shoes are red, and its hands are flesh-toned. The background is plain and beige, and in the lower right corner the name "Elmer Weise" is printed in black capital letters.
title: Marionette - "Ahab"
